comment: Base settings for tools/mkconfig.py (make config / make html WAVES=dump.vcd): copied into every generated <dump>.config.json.
select and rules only decide the starting per-signal settings of the generated file; edit that file afterwards.
select: depth = scope levels below the top that start shown, constants = show signals that never change,
hide = full-path patterns left out, budget = most value changes on one page (deeper levels are dropped first).
rules: {match: pattern(s) on the full path, width: 8 | '>1' | '>=32', then show/radix/color/style/fill/alias/enum}; later rules win.

page.intro: Signals are grouped by scope (click a group to fold it); hover a name for its full path.
